metadata.title: Auto Loan Payment - Fixed-Rate Estimator
metadata.description: Fixed-rate auto loan estimator with TILA-aligned disclosures, APR governance, and total cost of ownership modeling.

outputs.label: Financed amount
outputs.expression: max(vehicle_price - down_payment - (trade_in_value - amount_owed_on_trade), 0) + dealer_fees + registration_fees + extended_warranty_cost + (max(vehicle_price - down_payment - (trade_in_value - amount_owed_on_trade), 0) * sales_tax_rate / 100)

outputs.label: Periodic payment
outputs.expression: ((use_tier_rate > 0 ? credit_score_tier : annual_percentage_rate) / 100 / payments_per_year) === 0 ? (max(vehicle_price - down_payment - (trade_in_value - amount_owed_on_trade), 0) + dealer_fees + registration_fees + extended_warranty_cost + (max(vehicle_price - down_payment - (trade_in_value - amount_owed_on_trade), 0) * sales_tax_rate / 100)) / (term_months / 12 * payments_per_year) : (((use_tier_rate > 0 ? credit_score_tier : annual_percentage_rate) / 100 / payments_per_year) * (max(vehicle_price - down_payment - (trade_in_value - amount_owed_on_trade), 0) + dealer_fees + registration_fees + extended_warranty_cost + (max(vehicle_price - down_payment - (trade_in_value - amount_owed_on_trade), 0) * sales_tax_rate / 100))) / (1 - pow(1 + (use_tier_rate > 0 ? credit_score_tier : annual_percentage_rate) / 100 / payments_per_year, -(term_months / 12 * payments_per_year)))

outputs.label: Total cost of ownership
outputs.expression: ((((use_tier_rate > 0 ? credit_score_tier : annual_percentage_rate) / 100 / payments_per_year) === 0 ? (max(vehicle_price - down_payment - (trade_in_value - amount_owed_on_trade), 0) + dealer_fees + registration_fees + extended_warranty_cost + (max(vehicle_price - down_payment - (trade_in_value - amount_owed_on_trade), 0) * sales_tax_rate / 100)) / (term_months / 12 * payments_per_year) : (((use_tier_rate > 0 ? credit_score_tier : annual_percentage_rate) / 100 / payments_per_year) * (max(vehicle_price - down_payment - (trade_in_value - amount_owed_on_trade), 0) + dealer_fees + registration_fees + extended_warranty_cost + (max(vehicle_price - down_payment - (trade_in_value - amount_owed_on_trade), 0) * sales_tax_rate / 100))) / (1 - pow(1 + (use_tier_rate > 0 ? credit_score_tier : annual_percentage_rate) / 100 / payments_per_year, -(term_months / 12 * payments_per_year)))))) * (term_months / 12 * payments_per_year) + down_payment + max(trade_in_value, 0) + ((annual_insurance + annual_maintenance + annual_fuel) * (term_months / 12))

introduction: Regulation Z oriented fixed-rate auto loan estimator with negative equity, fee, and tax handling.
Outputs include financed amount, payment schedule, and total cost of ownership signals.
methodology: Amortization uses a level-payment fixed-rate formula with deterministic rounding at the display layer.
how_is_calculated: Taxable base equals vehicle price minus down payment minus net trade-in equity.
Financed amount includes taxable base, dealer fees, registration, optional warranty, and sales tax.
Payment uses APR and payment frequency with a zero-rate fallback.
Total cost of ownership adds operating costs and up-front outlays.
APR selection is governed by the credit tier toggle and manual override.
examples: Example: $30,000 price, $3,000 down, $0 trade-in, 8% tax, $500 fees, 5% APR, 60 months -> payment and totals are estimates only.

faqs.question: How is negative equity handled?
faqs.answer: Negative equity equals amount owed on trade-in minus trade-in value and increases the financed amount.

faqs.question: Why do APR and interest rate differ?
faqs.answer: APR reflects the cost of credit and can include certain finance charges, while the interest rate reflects the base cost of borrowing.

faqs.question: Does this replace lender disclosures?
faqs.answer: No. Final lender disclosures control and may differ due to lender-specific fees or timing.

glossary.definition: Annual Percentage Rate as defined by Regulation Z, reflecting the cost of credit over a year.
The amount owed on a trade-in that exceeds its value.
Loan payments plus out-of-pocket and operating costs across the selected term.

disclosures.interest_rate_vs_apr: Interest rate is the nominal cost of borrowing. APR includes certain finance charges and may differ from the interest rate.
disclosures.tila_notice: APR calculations are governed by Regulation Z and Appendix J for closed-end credit. Lender disclosures control.
disclosures.estimate_notice: This tool provides estimates for planning and comparison.

inputs.trade_in_value: If provided, reduces the taxable base and financed amount.
inputs.amount_owed_on_trade: Negative equity rolls into the financed amount.

limitations.jurisdiction: Tax treatment varies by state and dealer; verify local rules.
limitations.fees: Some fees may be excluded from APR or handled differently by lenders.
limitations.rounding: Display rounding is applied for readability and may differ from lender statements.
